{{Quote|This is Rescue 3. We're off. Cover us.| ''Rescue 3'' to [[Bravo Squadron/Legends|Bravo Flight]]|<ref name="Starfighter" />}}
'''''Rescue 3''''' was the callsign of a [[Rescue Boat]] that served [[Rescue Flight]] during the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]] by the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]].

==History==
{{Quote|We're pretty low in the water. Hope you're not in a hurry.| ''Rescue 3'' during the [[Raid on the Solleu River]]|<ref name="Starfighter" />}}
In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]] to [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].</ref> ''Rescue 3'' participated in a joint effort by Rescue Flight and [[Bravo Squadron/Legends|Bravo Flight]] to [[Raid on the Solleu River|raid]] a [[Trade Federation prison camp|Federation prison camp]] on the [[Solleu River/Legends|Solleu River]].<ref name="Starfighter" />

Under the protection of Bravo Flight, ''Rescue 3'' liberated its designated prison camp, rendezvoused with [[Rescue 1 (Rescue Boat)|''Rescue 1'']] and [[Rescue 2 (Rescue Boat)|''Rescue 2'']], and was led to the [[Europa Islands]].<ref name="Starfighter" />

Despite reporting being low in the water en route, ''Rescue 3'' successfully made land and transferred their passengers to the [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] ''[[Mercatan]]''.<ref name="Starfighter" />

==Behind the scenes==
''Rescue 3'' appeared in the [[2001]] video game [[Star Wars: Starfighter (video game)|''Star Wars: Starfighter'']], voiced by [[Neil Ross]].<ref name="Starfighter" />
